name: Upshur County, TX
findings: Upshur County has 61 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Upshur County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Upshur County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Upshur County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.
